notes:
I found three real venues, but none of them has Dec 27–30 hours posted on its own page that I could read. All three stay in as unconfirmed references.

- **Montréal Science Centre:** its holiday-hours posts are for past years, not 2026. One says 
it was open 10am to 6pm from December 26 to December 30
. Another covers the 2024–25 holidays. I'm not treating either as this year's schedule.
- **Biodôme and Insectarium:** Espace pour la vie's own schedule page only showed the week of October 12, 2026. It lists 
Biodôme: 9 a.m. – 5 p.m.. Insectarium: 9 a.m. – 5 p.m.
 for that week. Other sites say both close on Mondays, and Dec 28 is a Monday. That comes from third-party pages, so treat it as a lead and ring to check.
- **Biosphère (not a pick):** Parc Jean-Drapeau's page does show Dec 28 as 
Closed
. I left it out because its Dec 27, 29 and 30 times were cut off in what I read, and nothing there says it suits toddlers.

I couldn't search playgrounds, so there's no pick for those.
